answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Hardware-signed execution quotes per key; a farm of clones shares one TPM and one quote fails the count. Trust accrues only through verified work; a grove of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady quartz at 10 percent per epoch, and fable-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
